newsitem.title: BULGARIA: Bulgaria Feb forex reserves rise to $445.5 mln.
newsitem.headline: Bulgaria Feb forex reserves rise to $445.5 mln.

text.p: The Bulgarian National Bank (BNB) foreign exchange reserves rose by $30.5 million in February to $445.5 million, the BNB said on Thursday.
BNB FX RESERVES, FEB JAN FEB'96
"Reserves rose due to BNB net foreign currency purchases last month," a central bank official said.

Dollar supply has risen on the local interbank market since the beginning of February and the lev gained to around 1,750 per dollar on Thursday from 3,200 on February 7 as the interim government launched financial stabilisation measures.

Growing optimism among traders about a new funding deal with the International Monetary Fund (IMF) also contributed to the rise in dollar supply and the central bank took advantage of it to boost reserves, foreign currency dealers said.
An IMF mission is currently in Sofia for talks on introduction of a tough fixed exchange rate regime, a currency board system, and a new stand-by agreement.

Reserves have sunk to their minimum in January as Bulgaria was undergoing its worst financial crisis caused by mismanagement of the economy by the ruling ex-communists. -- Sofia Newsroom, (++359-2) 981 8569; 981 4145
